Summarize procedure-day completeness by year and procedure slot

Source: R/prday-completeness.R
nis_prday_completeness.Rd

Counts matched procedure slots with known, missing, negative/sentinel, or absent PRDAY values. Prefix matching and day classification follow nis_flag_pr() and nis_flag_pr_timing(); only slots whose procedure code matches pr are counted. Counts are unweighted discharge-slot counts. This is a descriptive completeness summary: it does not impute days or judge whether the observed completeness is acceptable.

Usage

nis_prday_completeness(.data, pr, system = c("icd10", "icd9"))

Arguments

.data

A data frame or lazy DuckDB query with YEAR.

pr

Character vector of procedure code prefixes, normalized and matched under the same rules as nis_flag_pr().

system

Code system: "icd10" uses I10_PR<n> (default); "icd9" uses PR<n>.

Value

An in-memory tibble with one row per year and procedure slot. matched_slots counts matching procedure slots; known_day, missing_day, sentinel_invalid_day, and absent_prday_column partition those matches. pct_known is 100 * known_day / matched_slots, or NA when there are no matched slots. A PRDAY column is considered absent when it is absent from the input query's schema. A unified multi-file query does not retain source-file field presence by year. When present, NA days count as missing and all negative days (including HCUP sentinels) count as sentinel/invalid, matching nis_flag_pr_timing().

See also

Defining cohorts.

Other cohort-definition: nis_attrition(), nis_audit_code_transition(), nis_ccsr_codes(), nis_dx_sensitivity(), nis_flag_dx(), nis_flag_dx_position(), nis_flag_pr(), nis_flag_pr_timing()

Examples

toy <- data.frame(
  YEAR = c(2020L, 2020L, 2021L),
  I10_PR1 = c("02UG0JZ", "02UG0JZ", "02UG0JZ"),
  I10_PR2 = c("0JH604Z", "OTHER", "0JH604Z"),
  PRDAY1 = c(0L, -99L, 1L), PRDAY2 = c(1L, NA_integer_, -88L)
)
nis_prday_completeness(toy, c("02UG0", "0JH60"))
#> # A tibble: 4 × 8
#>    YEAR  slot matched_slots known_day missing_day sentinel_invalid_day
#>   <int> <int>         <int>     <int>       <int>                <int>
#> 1  2020     1             2         1           0                    1
#> 2  2020     2             1         1           0                    0
#> 3  2021     1             1         1           0                    0
#> 4  2021     2             1         0           0                    1
#> # ℹ 2 more variables: absent_prday_column <int>, pct_known <dbl>
